item.tib: ma mo yang snying 'dus pa'i rgyud las sbyin sreg las kyi mtha' sdud
item.coloph: bdag 'dra rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal lam/ mi 'gyur gsang sngags grags pa o rgyan bde chen gling pa can gyis gyim shod zangs brag rin chen 'bar ba nas gter du drangs te/ slar 'bri rdza zal mo sgang du shog ser las bshus shing / yi ge pa ni 'dan chung gi rus pas drung lam shri seng has bskran pas dge bas kha lag 'grel ('brel) thob 'gro rnams/ rnam mkhyen yum gyi go 'phang thob pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
